leaves.name: hL29R
leaves.doc: Tian-Yuan-Zhang, arXiv:1411.4728v1 Lemma 2.9 (source L1062-1066) as printed, over the genuine test vector and genus period, squarefree 1 < n = 1, 3 mod 8, n != 3, for every real sign choice of script-L
leaves.flag: restricted: printed Lemma 2.9 for squarefree 1 < n = 1, 3 mod 8, n != 3, for every real sign choice of script-L (TYZ's script-L is real, L338-353; the open leaf hL29 is the same statement for integer sign choices, which presuppose Theorem 1.1); TYZ: n = 1, 2, 3; the print is false at n = 3 (h29-fix); for n != 3, w_K = 1 and the print agrees with its proof L1068-1077; unread

leaves.name: hTun
leaves.doc: Tunnell's formula: for odd squarefree n, L(C_n, 1) = beta (A(n) - 2B(n))^2 / (16 sqrt n), beta = int_1^oo dx/sqrt(x^3 - x), A(n) = #{2x^2 + y^2 + 8z^2 = n}, B(n) = #{2x^2 + y^2 + 32z^2 = n}; Tunnell, Invent. Math. 72 (1983) 323-334 (theorem number UNVERIFIED)
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf, no reading recorded; theorem number UNVERIFIED (the L-value formula for odd squarefree n); printed presentation UNVERIFIED among the equivalent forms beta (A - 2B)^2/(16 sqrt n) = beta (B - A/2)^2/(4 sqrt n) = beta a(n)^2/(4 sqrt n); checked numerically on 30 odd squarefree n <= 187 (scratch/h11-reduce/tunnell_check.py); only n = 1, 3 used
leaves.source: J. B. Tunnell, A classical Diophantine problem and modular forms of weight 3/2, Invent. Math. 72 (1983) 323-334 (theorem number UNVERIFIED); also N. Koblitz, Introduction to elliptic curves and modular forms, GTM 97, Ch. IV (locator UNVERIFIED)
